confirm.description: Omitted/false returns a preview without saving. Re-run with true to save.

label.description: Display name for the group, e.g. "Enterprise". Must be unique across groups.

tags.description: Ticket tags that map a ticket into this group. Matching is exact (no prefixes or substrings), a tag may appear in only one group, and the list may be empty (a placeholder tier).

groups.description: The complete ordered ladder, highest priority first — this REPLACES the saved list, so include every group you want to keep (read the current ladder with the conversations-response-targets-get tool first). Tickets whose tags match no group rank with the FIRST group. Pass null to reset the team to the built-in example groups.
